depth_field_formula: For each arm texture point p, project onto clamped S-E and E-W 2D segments. Choose nearest segment, interpolate 0→-60mm or -60→-100mm. Beyond wrist keep -100mm. Shoulder endpoint stays0. All protected-body texture stays0. Reconstruct each mesh vertex on its original camera ray using this camera-depth offset so approved screen projection and shoulder position are preserved.
